caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware jar with a light tan or beige color and two small handles on opposite sides near the top. The jar has a wide, slightly flared mouth and a gently rounded base. On the front, there is a decorative blue floral motif featuring elaborate flowers and leaves, painted in a rich cobalt blue color. Above the floral design, there is a blue inscription that reads "J & E NORTON BENNINGTON VT. 2." The jar casts a soft shadow on the plain, light-colored background. The artist's signature, "David S. DeVault," appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Churn
